verdict.rationale: The API docs tell clients to use the Retry-After header to decide how long to wait before retrying, which implies documented throttling behavior. The pack does not state numeric request limits or concurrency caps, so a user cannot know the actual limits before building automation at scale. missing for 10: explicit documented rate-limit numbers (requests per time window), documented concurrency caps, an explicit 429/throttling description, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I know the documented API rate limits and concurrency caps before building automation at scale

citations.quote: Consult the `Retry-After` response header to determine how long to wait (in seconds) before retrying the request.
